name: agent-studio
description: Self-hosted AI application studio with a Nuxt chat UI, DeepAgents/LangGraph runtime, live sites, runtime API routes, and Docker Compose deployment.
author: David Robertson

scripts.build: pnpm run web:build && pnpm run compose:build
scripts.lint: pnpm run web:lint && pnpm run runtime:lint
scripts.runtime:test: cd apps/runtime && uv run --python 3.13 --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.runtime:lint: cd apps/runtime && uv run --python 3.13 --extra dev ruff check src tests
scripts.test: pnpm run web:test && pnpm run runtime:test
scripts.release:check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run web:build && pnpm run compose:config
